'''Sarrish''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]'s [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]], and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned [[Unidentified Sarrish species|species]]. At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a member of the species, [[Veedaaz Awmetth/Legends|Veedaaz Awmetth]], represented the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Characteristics==
This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was recognizable for its [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] chain of pearl-like [[Moon/Legends|moons]], which were clearly visible in the night sky.<ref name="HM" /> It was a rocky world covered in craters, promontories, and plateaus.<ref name="RV" />

[[Salla C'airam|C'airam's]] [[Salla C'airam's cantina|cantina]] was located on Sarrish.<ref name="TERC" />

The planet was protected by the [[Sarrish Defense Force]].<ref name="RotS:TVD" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet and the sector were represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Veedaaz Awmetth/Legends|Veedaaz Awmetth]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|veedaaz|Awmetth, Veedaaz}}</ref> a Sarrish native.<ref name="RotS:TVD" /><ref name="AL" /> During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Sarrish was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] stronghold<ref name="TEA" /> and the site of the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]] which resulted in a Confederate victory.<ref name="MiA">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], this planet was the site of the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Drawmas Sma'Da]]'s capture at the hands of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]]. Shortly thereafter, it would also become the scene of [[Manaroo/Legends|Manaroo's]] successful wager with Sma'Da over the survival of her fiancee, [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]].<ref name="HM" />
